name: Arena-Hard-Auto v2.0
intro: Arena-Hard-Auto v2.0 从 Chatbot Arena 收集真实查询，形成 500 条高难提示和 250 条创意写作提示。高难集由 Gemini-2.5（官方）或 GPT-4.1（备选）对 o3-mini 成对评判，并控制长度与 Markdown 风格；创意写作集汇集 GPT-4.1 与 Gemini-2.5 对 Gemini-2.0 的独立评判，不做风格控制。
build_method: Chatbot Arena真实查询筛选, 困难与创意写作子集, 自动成对裁判
metric: 高难集：风格控制胜率；创意集：集成胜率
task_type: 开放式对话, 偏好评测
eval_feature: 真实困难提示, 创意写作, GPT-4.1与Gemini-2.5裁判, 风格控制
scale: 750条提示：500条困难查询, 250条创意写作
build_method_en: Chatbot Arena real-query filtering, hard and creative-writing subsets, automatic pairwise judging
eval_feature_en: Fresh hard prompts, creative writing, GPT-4.1 and Gemini-2.5 judges, style control
intro_en: Arena-Hard-Auto v2.0 draws real-world Chatbot Arena queries into 500 hard prompts and 250 creative-writing prompts. For hard prompts, Gemini-2.5 (official) or GPT-4.1 (alternative) judges against o3-mini with length and Markdown style control. Creative writing pools independent GPT-4.1 and Gemini-2.5 judgments against Gemini-2.0 without style control.
scale_en: 750 prompts: 500 hard queries and 250 creative-writing queries
metric_en: Hard: style-controlled win rate; creative: ensemble win rate

drawio_review_note: CORRECTED against arXiv:2406.11939v2 §4 for the BenchBuilder backbone, §5 for the paper-era judge method, and §6 for benchmark-quality metrics, plus official lmarena/arena-hard-auto@196f6b826783b3da7310e361a805fa36f0be83f3 README, config/arena-hard-v2.0.yaml, utils/judge_utils.py, and show_result.py. The paper's v0.1 GPT-4-Turbo/GPT-4-0314 judge chain is not the v2 workflow. Official v2 keeps 500 hard prompts and 250 creative-writing prompts separate: hard uses Gemini-2.5 officially or GPT-4.1 alternatively with o3-mini as baseline and Markdown/length style control, while creative writing pools independent GPT-4.1 and Gemini-2.5 judgments against a Gemini-2.0 baseline without style control.
